policy.admission: existing SMP eligibility, fixed affinity and schedulable/Online mask before preferences; physical exact current and all existing saved-frame/FPU/resource barriers retained
policy.ranking: minimum actual running-plus-Ready load, free physical core before occupied SMT siblings at equal load, bounded previous-CPU/cache preference
policy.hysteresis: prior CPU one-task slack only with no idle admissible candidate and no worse core class; existing one-quantum migration cooldown uses already published Ready time, no added global clock read
policy.domains: small immutable core/last-cache peer masks built once at boot seal; contradictory qualified core/package counts/vendors lose geometry trust, caches require matching complete same-package descriptors
policy.fallback: unknown geometry fabricates no sibling/cache domain and retains flat minimum-load behavior
policy.optimal_prior_cpu: Zero-work prior CPU with no busy admitted SMT sibling is optimal. One-work prior CPU when all admitted exact currents have logical work is also optimal: every admitted workload is at least one and every core occupied. Read only own/sibling pointers or small derived CPU-state bits; no global TaskView scan.
policy.current_work_floor: Private derived bit published with each exact current pointer and updated at all registry state changes plus existing raw state/idle setters, before runtime admission release. Includes exact Ready current even if linked. Used only as sufficient work floor, never as exact load or capacity; diagnostic queue invariant compares every real current with TaskCore.
policy.wake_time: Both production notification callers have just published ready_since_tick; singleton wake cooldown reuses that functional snapshot in the same runtime admission, instead of another global monotonic-clock publication.
policy.notification: move before source notification; exact transferred incoming task with empty former queue uses its already-published destination notification. Other remaining source work keeps its original notification.

Add a derived exact current-work floor at the scheduler owner so a one-unit prior CPU is provably optimal when every admitted CPU already has current work; the same sufficient fact rejects impossible idle-target searches. limits: Four virtual CPUs on normal topology and explicit one-package/two-core/two-thread topology. Initial/wake unbound worker case is deliberately a four-CPU fixture; larger systems keep other checks/full-CPU STANDARD, no product limit.
Native8CPU CPUID/domain grouping matches Linux sysfs, with a fixture-supplied qualified mask. This is not a new native R4OS scheduler/hardware/Windows boot acceptance.
No application affinity/work-class API, NUMA policy, hard realtime promise, hybrid performance ranking, CPU hotplug or over32CPU qualification. Those remain their roadmap owners.
